Downloaded files are retained unchanged. AudioPapkin and gfrog files are public high-quality MP3 previews; full original WAV requires a Freesound account. Remotion-hosted WAV files have their author and CC0 attribution documented in Remotion’s corresponding sound-effect page. SFXMint files are WAV with publisher SHA-256 checks. This selection uses three SFXMint downloads within the stated daily allowance.
